generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, creativity is something you practise in every part of the School of Sport. Each time you generate several explanations before testing one, each unexpected link you draw between a study and a session, each rough project idea you let develop, is the skill at work. It is also what research and professional practice in sport reward: finding fresh angles and turning them into questions you can test, sessions you can run, and services you can offer.
